text.arabic_uthmani: فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَكِبَا فِى ٱلسَّفِينَةِ خَرَقَهَا ۖ قَالَ أَخَرَقْتَهَا لِتُغْرِقَ أَهْلَهَا لَقَدْ جِئْتَ شَيْـًٔا إِمْرًۭا

words.gloss_range: sequential/resumptive connector that turns the prior pact into immediate narrative motion
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) does more than restart the story. It carries the agreement of 18:70 straight into action, so the departure begins as the grammatical consequence of the prior stipulation. The episode opens in sequence, not explanation.

topics.headline: pact becomes immediate action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first word makes the journey begin as the immediate consequence of the agreement in 18:70.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a sequential conjunction, and the CRITICAL rows consistently connect it to the prior pact and the launch of the first episode.

words.gloss_range: completed dual departure; locally travel and episode launch, with release-root pressure narrowed by the journey frame
words.root_gloss_range: release, loosening, and unbinding branches; the local Form VII dual frame selects setting out while preserving release pressure
words.prose: {{ar:ٱنطَلَقَا}} ({{tr:inṭalaqā}}) presents the two figures as an unnamed dual pair whose departure is complete before the ship scene begins. The root field of release and loosening makes the motion feel like being released into the test, but the local Form VII journey frame keeps the selected sense as setting out, not legal release. Because the same launch formula returns in 18:74 and 18:77, this first departure teaches the reader to hear a repeated episode pattern.

topics.headline: dual departure is complete and objectless
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the two travelers moving as an unnamed dual pair, with no destination stated before the scene narrows to the ship.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a Form VII perfect dual verb, and the local grammar supplies no object or destination.

topics.headline: release field colors departure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that departure feels like release into the test, while the local verb still means setting out rather than legal release.
topics.reason: V4 and QAC support the broad release root field, but the dual motion frame narrows the active sense to departure.

topics.headline: departure formula opens the three tests
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this first launch as the opening member of a repeated episode formula that returns in 18:74 and 18:77.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete same-surah references for the recurring departure formula, and nothing in the guardrails blocks the structural echo.

words.gloss_range: terminative temporal particle that compresses motion up to the first test threshold
words.prose: {{ar:حَتَّىٰٓ}} ({{tr:ḥattā}}) compresses the journey up to a limit. It does not linger over travel; it pushes the narration to the boarding threshold, where the first test becomes visible. In the larger formula, the threshold frame returns at test and journey thresholds (18:74, 18:77, 18:86, 18:90, 18:93), and here its answer arrives abruptly without a soft connector.

topics.headline: motion reaches a test threshold
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the journey is compressed up to a limit, and the first narratable moment is the boarding threshold.
topics.reason: QAC treats the particle as a temporal endpoint introducing the following frame, matching the CRITICAL termination rows.

topics.headline: threshold formula stages the shock
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the familiar threshold formula preparing an abrupt answer: the breach lands after the frame is complete.
topics.reason: The rows identify the repeated threshold formula and the asyndetic answer; the concrete references include 18:71, 18:74, 18:77, 18:86, 18:90, and 18:93.

words.gloss_range: expected-time threshold marker that makes boarding the condition for the sudden act
words.prose: {{ar:إِذَا}} ({{tr:idhā}}) makes the boarding the expected arrival point of the compressed journey. It frames the event as the condition for what follows: the ship must first be entered before the breach can answer the scene.

topics.headline: boarding is expected arrival
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the scene is not introduced as doubtful; boarding is the expected point reached by the compressed journey.
topics.reason: QAC marks a temporal adverb, and the CRITICAL rows distinguish expected-time force from an uncertain conditional.

topics.headline: arrival frame enables rupture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ship must first be entered before the breach can answer the temporal frame.
topics.reason: The particle participates in the paired threshold frame with the previous word and prepares the following act structurally.

words.gloss_range: completed dual boarding into a vessel; containment and carrier participation are locally active
words.root_gloss_range: mounting, riding, passengerhood, and composition; the local construction selects boarding into a carrier

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: containment preposition completing the boarding phrase

words.prose: {{ar:رَكِبَا}} ({{tr:rakibā}}) narrows open departure into enclosed boarding. With {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) and the ship phrase, the verb places both travelers inside a carrier, making them occupants before one of them damages the vessel. The wider riding and composition field remains useful as pressure, but the local construction selects concrete ship boarding, with vessel-crisis echoes such as 29:65 kept as background.

topics.headline: boarding becomes interior containment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the two travelers enter the ship as an interior domain, not merely mount a surface.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make the prepositional phrase complete the verb locally, selecting boarding into the ship.

topics.headline: riders become carried occupants
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the pair becoming carried occupants inside a structured vessel, while broader composition senses stay secondary.
topics.reason: The root field supports riding, passengerhood, and composition, but the local construction selects concrete ship boarding.

topics.headline: vessel boarding recalls crisis scenes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this calm boarding phrase against wider vessel-crisis language, while this scene specializes it as a test of perception.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide vessel-scene parallels including 29:65; the local ayah narrows the formula immediately toward breach.

words.gloss_range: containment preposition governing the ship and making boarding an interior relation
words.prose: {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) makes containment explicit. The travelers are not merely associated with the ship; the preposition governs the vessel as the interior domain of boarding. That matters because the next act violates the enclosure just established.

topics.headline: preposition makes the ship a container
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar first establishes the ship as a containing space, so the next act violates an enclosure.
topics.reason: QAC marks a governing preposition, and the rows consistently read it as the dependency that completes the boarding unit.

words.gloss_range: definite, governed vessel; a specific carrier whose pronouns, damage, and later explanation stay linked
words.root_gloss_range: ship/vessel with scraping or planing imagery in the root field; the local sense is the concrete specific ship
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّفِينَةِ}} ({{tr:al-safīnati}}) is a definite, governed ship, so later feminine suffixes can keep pointing back to one specific vessel. Its carrier role and scraping-root imagery make the normal water-cutting vessel resonate with the abnormal cut made in it, while the literal local sense remains the boarded ship. The rare specific ship term also sets up the later explanation in 18:79, so the object is not generic maritime scenery.

topics.headline: definite ship anchors pronouns
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one concrete ship becoming the grammatical anchor for the later feminine suffixes and the whole middle of the ayah.
topics.reason: QAC marks a definite genitive noun governed by the preposition; the following suffixes point back to this vessel.

topics.headline: carrier term carries scraping imagery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ship as a carrier that normally cuts through water, while the local sense remains the actual vessel being boarded.
topics.reason: V4 evidence supports vessel and scraping/planing imagery, but the water scene selects the concrete ship sense.

topics.headline: rare vessel word sets up later explanation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the vessel is not generic maritime background; the same specific ship term returns when the damage is explained in 18:79.
topics.reason: The rows identify the rare term and its return in 18:79, with a broader rescue-vessel resonance at 29:15 kept as secondary.

words.gloss_range: completed transitive breaching of the ship; broader rupture fields color but do not replace physical perforation
words.root_gloss_range: piercing, tearing, rupturing, and broader integrity-breaking; the ship suffix selects physical breach

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: second-person reproachful repetition of the breach verb

words.prose: {{ar:خَرَقَهَا}} ({{tr:kharaqahā}}) is a completed transitive breach of that ship, with the suffix carrying the vessel inside the verb. The root field lets the physical hole feel like a rupture of integrity, but the ship object keeps the local sense concrete. This terse narrated act prepares Musa’s immediate second-person echo in {{ar:أَخَرَقْتَهَا}} ({{tr:a-kharaqtahā}}), where the same breach becomes accusation.

topics.headline: suffix locks the breach to the ship
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a completed physical act done to the already introduced ship, not a vague damage event.
topics.reason: QAC marks a Form I perfect verb with a feminine object suffix referring to the ship, and attachment evidence supports that patient relation.

topics.headline: physical rupture carries integrity pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the hole in the vessel is also felt as a rupture of order, while the local lexical sense remains physical breaching.
topics.reason: The root field includes tearing and integrity-breaking, but the ship object blocks replacing the local sense with fabrication or abstract violation.

topics.headline: narration becomes accusation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the narrator’s terse breach preparing Musa’s immediate second-person repetition of the same act.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL echo rows connect this word to the following reproach form, while the 6:100 rupture-of-truth comparison remains a broader root-field resonance.

words.gloss_range: compact speech-entry verb that moves from narration into Musa’s protest
words.root_gloss_range: saying and speech-reporting; the local verb introduces direct protest speech
words.prose: {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) pivots from compressed action into direct protest. The speaker is not named, so Musa’s objection breaks in quickly, and the verb governs the whole quoted charge. In the episode pattern, this speech entry is the hinge where event becomes moral interruption, recurring in 18:71, 18:74, and 18:77.

topics.headline: protest breaks in through pro-drop speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices Musa’s protest entering abruptly, with the speaker recovered from context rather than named.
topics.reason: QAC marks a perfect speech verb, and the quoted scope is recoverable from the journey dyad and direct speech.

topics.headline: speech externalizes forbidden protest
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that speaking is itself the turn from silent witnessing to moral challenge after the prior stipulation.
topics.reason: The boundary context makes the speech verb more than a report marker: it opens the objection that the prior agreement had constrained.

topics.headline: speech marks repeated episode turns
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the speech verb as the repeated hinge where each Khidr episode turns from event to objection in 18:71, 18:74, and 18:77.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply same-surah protest-turn references and local collocation with accusation vocabulary.

words.gloss_range: reproachful second-person repetition of the breach verb, with agent and ship compressed into one accusation
words.root_gloss_range: same rupture root as word 8, now redirected into second-person reproach
words.prose: {{ar:أَخَرَقْتَهَا}} ({{tr:a-kharaqtahā}}) repeats the breach as a reproachful question, not a request for information. The form packs the interrogative, the addressed agent, and the ship as patient into one word. What the narrator stated as he breached it now becomes did you breach it, so person shift and repetition turn observation into accusation.

topics.headline: question form is accusation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Musa is not asking for information; the interrogative shape performs rebuke.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the interrogative hamza as reproachful, and the witnessed completed breach makes an information question unsuitable.

topics.headline: agent and ship are packed into the verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the servant addressed as agent and the ship retained as patient inside one compact accusation word.
topics.reason: The second-person suffix and feminine object suffix are both present in the local form, matching the attachment relations.

topics.headline: same breach shifts from he to you
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same physical breach move from narrator’s report into Musa’s direct second-person charge.
topics.reason: The root and object suffix repeat from the previous verb, while person and interrogative force change the discourse role.

words.gloss_range: purpose/result lām subordinating the drowning clause to the breach accusation
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) subordinates the drowning clause to the breach question. In Musa’s wording, the particle can sound like purpose and can shade toward consequence, so the charge sits on the pressure point between intended drowning and a disastrous outcome imputed to the act.

topics.headline: lām turns breach into alleged outcome
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices Musa attaching drowning to the breach as purpose or consequence, while the grammar leaves intent versus outcome under pressure.
topics.reason: QAC marks purpose lām governing the subjunctive, but CRITICAL and grammar rows preserve the possible consequence shading.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive causative drowning verb; main reading assigns direct agency, variants expose consequence readings
words.root_gloss_range: drowning, sinking, and overwhelming submersion; the local form is causative in the main reading
words.prose: {{ar:تُغْرِقَ}} ({{tr:tughriqa}}) escalates damage into possible death. In the main reading, the Form IV causative and second-person prefix make the servant the one who would cause the ship’s people to drown. Accepted variant forms keep the drowning danger but redistribute agency, so the word preserves the tension between direct intent, consequence, and Quranic drowning scenes of peril or punishment (17:69, 36:43).

topics.headline: main reading assigns drowning agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Musa’s main wording makes the servant the grammatical cause of drowning the ship’s people.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a Form IV subjunctive with second-person subject and a direct human object, supporting direct causative force.

topics.headline: variant readings redistribute blame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that accepted variants keep the drowning danger while shifting how directly agency falls on the servant.
topics.reason: Variant evidence can inform contrast, but it does not override the canonical local parse represented by QAC.

topics.headline: drowning invokes total peril
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the accusation drawing on the grave field of drowning and overwhelming loss, while the local sense stays physical peril at sea.
topics.reason: The root and corpus fields support drowning, divine water-crisis contexts, and total absorption imagery, all narrowed by the local purpose clause.

words.gloss_range: ship-linked people as affected belonging-community, not an abstract object
words.root_gloss_range: people, family, belonging, and rightful connection; the local phrase names the ship’s human group
words.prose: {{ar:أَهْلَهَا}} ({{tr:ahlahā}}) makes the endangered party the ship’s people, a belonging-community tied to the vessel by suffix. The breach is therefore no longer only property damage; it is heard as harm to humans connected with the ship. Variant case evidence can make the people grammatical subject of drowning, but the main local reading keeps them as the affected object in Musa’s charge. The same people-root also anticipates the later town community in 18:77, while the Noahic rescue-peril comparison at 23:27 keeps the human stakes in view.

topics.headline: suffix makes people belong to the ship domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the damaged object becoming a bridge to a human group attached to it.
topics.reason: The possessive suffix points back to the ship and makes the human group grammatically dependent on that vessel.

topics.headline: affected object is a community
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the alleged victims are not cargo or a count of passengers but a relational community.
topics.reason: The root field and singular collective form support belonging and community while the main syntax makes the group the object of the drowning charge.

topics.headline: variant makes the people subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the variant case changes the people from object of causation to subject of drowning, without erasing the main accusative reading.
topics.reason: Accepted variant evidence is valid for contrast, while QAC records the main local accusative object analysis.

topics.headline: people language recurs in tested communities
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this ship community anticipating later encountered people in 18:77, while the Noahic rescue-peril comparison at 23:27 keeps the human stakes high.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows connect the root to later community testing and broader water-rescue contexts, including Noahic comparison at 23:27.

words.gloss_range: emphatic lām of verdict, distinct from the prior purpose lām

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: emphatic lām plus verification particle opening the verdict formula

words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) begins the emphatic verdict in {{ar:لَقَدْ}} ({{tr:laqad}}). It is not the earlier purpose particle; it shifts from alleged purpose to firm assertion, stacking with the following verification particle before Musa names what has been committed.

topics.headline: emphasis replaces purpose with verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a second lām function: the earlier particle introduced alleged purpose, but this one launches emphatic judgment.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as emphatic in the formula with the following verification particle, distinct from the earlier purpose particle.

words.gloss_range: verification particle before a perfect verb, making Musa’s verdict treat the act as completed fact
words.prose: {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) verifies the following perfect verb and treats the act as completed. Musa no longer frames the matter as a question; the emphatic formula presents the moral case as already closed. The same verdict frame becomes a baseline for escalation in 18:74.

topics.headline: qad closes the moral case
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices Musa treating the act as already completed and morally settled before naming the grave thing.
topics.reason: QAC marks a certainty particle before a perfect verb, and the CRITICAL rows select verification rather than possibility.

topics.headline: formula returns with stronger labels
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this first verdict formula becoming the baseline for a stronger accusation in 18:74.
topics.reason: The inter rows provide the concrete formula comparison between 18:71 and 18:74.

words.gloss_range: second-person perfect in the accusation formula; coming-language becomes committing or bringing about a thing
words.root_gloss_range: coming and arrival, with transitive idiom for bringing or committing when it takes an object
words.prose: {{ar:جِئْتَ}} ({{tr:jiʾta}}) turns coming-language into the transitive idiom of bringing about or committing a thing. The second-person perfect keeps responsibility fixed on the servant, while the object slot prepares the final descriptor. As part of the accusation formula also seen in 18:74 and 19:27, the verb bridges event and evaluation.

topics.headline: coming becomes committing a thing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ordinary coming-language has become an idiom for bringing about or committing a judged act.
topics.reason: The verb takes an object here, so the local construction narrows the broad arrival root into a transitive accusation formula.

topics.headline: second person fixes blame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final verdict still aimed directly at the servant as addressee.
topics.reason: The perfect second-person form and surrounding direct speech preserve personal address from the breach question through the verdict.

topics.headline: verb bridges event and evaluation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this verb as the hinge that turns the breached ship into a moral object within a recognizable accusation formula.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows connect the construction to 18:74 and 19:27 while the local clause specializes it with the final grave descriptor.

words.gloss_range: indefinite object noun that lets the act become a judgeable thing before the final descriptor
words.root_gloss_range: thingness and objecthood; the local accusative makes the observed act available for moral classification

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: grave final descriptor qualifying or restating the unnamed thing

words.prose: {{ar:شَيْـًٔا}} ({{tr:shayʾan}}) makes the observed act into an unnamed object of judgment. Its breadth is not left vague, because {{ar:إِمْرًۭا}} ({{tr:imran}}) immediately qualifies or restates it; together the matching accusatives form one compact charge. The word also carries boundary pressure: the thing Musa was told not to ask about becomes the thing he now judges.

topics.headline: thing becomes judgeable object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the act first being made into an unnamed object so the final word can classify it.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as the accusative object of the preceding verb, and agreement with the following descriptor ties the judgment to it.

topics.headline: prohibited thing becomes judged thing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the broad word for thing carrying boundary memory: what Musa was told not to ask about becomes the very thing he judges.
topics.reason: The root field supports broad objecthood, while same-surah discourse evidence connects this occurrence to questions, restraint, and judgment.

topics.headline: stable object slot takes escalating labels
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the stable accusation frame whose descriptor can escalate from this grave label to later stronger charges in 18:74 and 19:27.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete formula parallels and the paired accusative cadence that binds object and descriptor.

words.gloss_range: grave descriptor at the ayah close; command/affair root echoes are narrowed into moral enormity
words.root_gloss_range: command, affair, authority, abundance, and enormity; the local form selects grave excess rather than neutral command
words.prose: {{ar:إِمْرًۭا}} ({{tr:imran}}) is the ayah’s closing moral label. It turns the unnamed thing into a grave matter, with qualifier and apposition both possible in the accusative indefinite form. The root field of command and affair is narrowed into enormity here, so Musa’s pledged obedience to command in 18:69 returns with reversed valence as horror at an act he sees as excessive; later descriptors in 18:74 and 19:27 calibrate the accusation series further.

topics.headline: grave descriptor closes the grammar
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final word converting the unnamed thing into a grave verdict, whether read as qualifier or apposition.
topics.reason: QAC allows the descriptor to qualify the preceding object, and the CRITICAL rows preserve the appositional pressure of the same accusative indefinite form.

topics.headline: command root becomes enormity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the authority and command field returning in reversed moral valence: obedience to command in 18:69 becomes horror at enormity in 18:71.
topics.reason: The root field includes command and affair, but the local form selects grave excess rather than neutral command; the 18:69 echo supplies the irony.

topics.headline: first label in accusation series
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this grave label as the first calibration point in a descriptor series that intensifies in 18:74 and is echoed by accusation language in 19:27.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete descriptor comparisons across 18:71, 18:74, and 19:27.

topics.headline: root, sound, and closure converge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah landing not on the physical breach but on Musa’s morally charged perception of it.
topics.reason: The final position, root echo, and speech-verdict cluster all converge at the last word without contradiction from the guardrails.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ركبا في السفينة / خرقها / لتغرق أهلها
baseline_models.mechanism: Boarding places riders inside a carrier whose intact hull excludes the sea; piercing that hull reverses the enclosure and lets the surrounding medium threaten the affiliated human group.

activation_trace.role: Insertion and composition supply the riders' placement within the vessel and make enclosure the mechanism's first step.
The ship that cleaves the water supplies controlled passage through the medium while its hull serves as the protective boundary.
The literal split or puncture supplies the loss of continuity through which the outside can enter.
Drowning in water supplies the feared consequence of the failed boundary.
The group of proximity and belonging turns damage to the vessel into a threat to a collective rather than to an isolated object.

changed_reading.before: A man damages a boat and alarms his companion.
changed_reading.after: The act attacks a life-maintaining boundary: the carrier that gathers people safely above water is opened to the medium it must exclude.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أخرقتها لتغرق أهلها لقد جئت شيئا إمرا
baseline_models.mechanism: The response compresses observation, attributed purpose, anticipated total consequence, and moral classification into one utterance: a visible puncture becomes an intention to drown and then a grave thing.

activation_trace.role: Speech that runs as supposition supplies the inferential character of the accusation rather than merely its vocal delivery.
The opposite of gentleness and measured action supplies the immediate moral appearance assigned to the breach.
Engulfing and exhaustive inclusion supply the totalized outcome projected from the local damage.
Bringing and presenting a thing turns the deed into an object placed before moral judgment.
The grave, reprehensible matter supplies the utterance's final categorical verdict.

changed_reading.before: Moses voices understandable outrage at dangerous damage.
changed_reading.after: Moses constructs a compact causal indictment, moving from what he sees to why it was done and what it means before any account is given.

baseline_models.mechanism: The vessel is imaged as what cuts the face of the water, but the action makes that cutter itself the cut object; controlled external cleavage is reversed into a dangerous inward opening.

activation_trace.role: The ship's cutting of the water supplies the normal, controlled direction of penetration.
The split or puncture reverses that direction by making the water-cutting vessel the penetrated surface.
Riding on the back of a mount supplies the stable above-and-below relation that the breach threatens to invert.

changed_reading.before: The hull receives an isolated act of damage.
changed_reading.after: The scene reverses the topology of travel: the cutter that should remain above and divide the water is itself divided and exposed to being overtaken by it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding compact establishes an epistemic order: the follower lacks encompassing knowledge of the act's interior, must withhold questions, and is to wait until the guide originates its report. The focus reverses that order by asking, assigning purpose, and classifying the deed before the promised mention.

activation_trace.role: Complete encompassing in knowledge supplies the epistemic perimeter that the follower explicitly lacks.
Knowledge of the report and the inside of a matter supplies the hidden interior unavailable from the visible breach alone.
Questioning and requesting supply the expressly deferred response that erupts in the focus.
Speech renewed as report supplies the future explanatory event that should precede settled judgment.
A matter running upon the tongue supplies the promised moment when the withheld account becomes speakable.
Suppositional speech anchors the premature causal attribution in the focus.
The thing as an object of knowledge and report is classified before its promised report arrives.
The grave-matter branch anchors the verdict produced ahead of the account.

structural_cues: 18:67-68 repeatedly predicts inability to remain patient precisely because encompassing report-knowledge is absent.
18:70 orders no question about a thing until the guide himself produces its mention; 18:71 immediately supplies an interrogative, a purpose clause, and a verdict.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies missing interior knowledge and a delayed-report rule; I infer that the rule governs not only turn-taking but the temporal order of interpretation. A live alternative is that it forbids questioning alone, while leaving the moral judgment independently warranted.

changed_reading.before: The question is an immediate ethical protest against an apparently lethal act.
changed_reading.after: The protest is also an epistemic foreclosure: the visible effect is made into a known purpose and a final moral object before the act's interior report is allowed to exist.

context_deltas.mechanism: The explanation turns the local breach into a deliberately visible disqualification. A vessel that supports workers would otherwise fall under a ruler's totalizing forcible seizure; marking it as defective sacrifices local integrity to preserve the carrier, its livelihood, and its people from complete loss.

activation_trace.role: The literal puncture anchors the local damage whose function is reclassified by the explanation.
Drowning as killing supplies the lethal intent alleged in the focus and reversed by the later account.
The affiliated group anchors the people whose preservation, not destruction, emerges as the intervention's social end.
The repeated water-cleaving vessel identifies both the workers' carrier and the category targeted for seizure.
Work as wage and livelihood makes the vessel productive infrastructure rather than merely replaceable property.
Will and intention supply the deliberate aim to impose a defect rather than cause uncontrolled destruction.
Rule and sovereignty supply the asymmetric power behind the threat.
Seizure and capture supply the mechanism of dispossession avoided by the defect.
Totality and encompassing supply the ruler's indiscriminate sweep over the vessel class.
Taking by injustice and force supplies the predatory pressure that makes protective damage intelligible.

structural_cues: 18:79 states that the vessel belongs to needy people working at sea.
The branchless focus explanation أعيبها explicitly names intended defect, while the ruler takes every vessel by force.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intentional defect, working owners, and total forcible taking; I infer that visible impairment removes the vessel from the ruler's desirable or eligible targets. The live alternative is that the ruler's exact selection rule is unstated, although the explanation strongly links defect to escape.

changed_reading.before: The hole is reckless damage aimed toward drowning the people aboard.
changed_reading.after: The hole is calibrated counter-seizure damage: a limited loss of soundness preserves the whole livelihood-bearing vessel and its vulnerable owners from predatory capture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The vessel and wall form opposed boundary operations governed by the same preservation logic. A sound enclosure is opened because visible soundness exposes its owners to seizure; a failing enclosure is straightened because continued concealment protects orphaned owners and their stored wealth.

activation_trace.role: The water-cleaving vessel supplies the first protective enclosure.
The opening in that enclosure supplies the destructive-looking pole of the paired intervention.
Forcible unjust taking supplies the exposure from which opening the first boundary protects its owners.
The raised wall supplies the second protective enclosure.
Undoing a completed construction supplies the wall's imminent loss of boundary function.
Standing and bodily erection supply restoration of the failing enclosure.
Children cut off from a guardian supply the vulnerability served by preserving the wall.
Stored and preserved wealth supplies what continued concealment under the wall protects.
Mercy and tenderness supply the stated ethical frame common to the preservation of vulnerable owners.

structural_cues: 18:79 explains deliberate impairment of the vessel in relation to forcible seizure.
18:77 presents a wall about to fall and its restoration; 18:82 locates orphaned owners and concealed treasure beneath it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one impaired boundary, one restored boundary, and preservation explanations for vulnerable owners; I supply the common rule that exposure determines whether protection requires opening or stabilizing. A live alternative is that the two acts are parallel only narratively, without a shared boundary calculus.

changed_reading.before: The puncture is a uniquely destructive and anti-repair act.
changed_reading.after: The puncture is one pole of a paired craft of protection: expose or weaken a boundary when sound appearance attracts predation, but restore it when concealment preserves a vulnerable owner's future.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next intervention repeats the focus sequence: departure, shocking visible act, accusatory question, and the formula 'you have brought a thing' plus an evaluative adjective. The recurrence makes the focus accusation the first operation of a stable judgment template under incomplete knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Suppositional speech anchors the first inferred indictment.
Bringing a thing anchors the first instance of the repeated verdict formula.
The reported or knowable thing supplies the open object immediately closed by an adjective.
The grave reprehensible matter supplies the first cycle's moral classification.
Unimpeded departure restarts the narrative cycle after the first correction.
Actual killing supplies a more irreversible visible act for the second judgment cycle.
A second supposition-bearing utterance repeats the interpretive response.
The life-bearing self supplies the explicit human loss around which the second accusation is built.
The repeated bringing of a thing reproduces the focus formula.
The repeated thing again becomes a prematurely settled object of report.
The difficult, severe, and strange matter supplies the second cycle's intensified unfamiliarity.

structural_cues: 18:71 and 18:74 share the sequence فانطلقا ... قال أ... لقد جئت شيئا followed by an evaluative adjective.
18:72 and 18:75 answer both cycles with the repeated prediction that Moses cannot sustain patience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies near-identical syntax around two visibly transgressive acts; I infer that repetition diagnoses a stable interpretive habit of closing from appearance to verdict. A live alternative is that the parallel only structures escalating trials and does not comment on the form of judgment itself.

changed_reading.before: The focus contains a singular, spontaneous accusation prompted by danger to passengers.
changed_reading.after: The accusation is the first execution of a repeated judgment template: visible rupture is converted into a settled moral 'thing' before its hidden relation and outcome are narrated.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links branch images across fish, sea, vessel, and puncture rather than following the explicit explanation. It remains anchored in the focus vessel and its breach, with exact nearby path and tunnel cues. Downstream prose should present it as a spatial resonance, not as a claimed hidden allegory or causal explanation.

activation_trace.role: The vessel cleaving the face of water supplies one controlled passage through a surface.
The split or hole supplies the reciprocal passage of water through the vessel's surface.
An extended traversable path supplies the fish's line of passage through the same medium.
The sea as a broad split supplies a medium already imaged as opening or cleavage.
The descending tunnel or burrow supplies a channel made through what ordinarily appears continuous.

changed_reading.before: The hull breach is an isolated opening in a travel episode.
changed_reading.after: The breach joins a local topology of reciprocal passages: the fish paths through the sea, the vessel cuts across it, and then the sea is given a path into the vessel.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates polysemy within repeated ء م ر rather than equating the surface senses. It remains anchored in the focus verdict إمرا and the final exact-root denial عن أمري. Downstream prose should call it an agency echo that holds grave appearance against non-self-originated action, not proof that 'grave thing' and 'command' have one lexical sense.

activation_trace.role: The grave reprehensible matter supplies Moses's categorical naming of the act.
Command as request and obligation supplies the authority Moses promises not to disobey.
One's affair and condition supply Moses's appeal concerning the burden placed on his own case.
Bringing an act into being supplies the final explicit statement about agency.
Command and obligation, negated as the actor's own, relocate the action's authorizing source beyond private initiative.
Return to outcome and final issue supplies the retrospective frame in which the first verdict is re-read.

changed_reading.before: إمرا is a fixed moral label for an autonomous deed attributed to the visible actor.
changed_reading.after: The grave appearance remains, but the final echo 'not from my own amr' separates the act's visible agent from its claimed authorizing source and destabilizes the first assignment of agency.

strongest_changes: The later vessel explanation reverses alleged drowning intent into calibrated damage that protects a livelihood-bearing vessel from total forcible seizure.
The prior no-question compact reframes the focus utterance as judgment produced before the promised interior report, not only as moral protest.
The restored wall makes the punctured hull one half of an opposed boundary practice: weaken what attracts predation and stabilize what preserves vulnerable owners through concealment.
summary.what_was_special: The focus became simultaneously a material boundary event and an epistemic-order event. Its strongest activation came from the same local hole changing scale from lethal rupture to protective defect, while the fish's sea-path and the later wall preserved a more exploratory topology of openings, concealment, and passage.
remaining_uncertainties: The explanation does not specify the breach's size, repairability, or the ruler's exact selection procedure, so the controlled-disqualification mechanics remain inferred.
The cutter-cut reversal and fish-tunnel linkage are branch-grounded spatial resonances, not evidence that the narrative explicitly identifies the three passages.
The ء م ر echo depends on preserving distinct senses across repeated roots and should not be rendered as lexical equivalence.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **A visible defect is read as its nearest catastrophic purpose.** `ق و ل` B001 (“uttered speech”) supplies Moses’ causal arrow from hole to drowning; the packet supplies only damage and his question. The later explanation adds the absent king and reverses the arrow toward preservation (18:79). I infer that proximity makes one consequence salient while hidden social context changes the act’s function. The ayah stages a grammatically confident but under-contextualized reading.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:79 explicitly reversed Moses’ drowning arrow into protection from confiscation.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **A hole immediately collapsed into an incompetence narrative.** `خ ر ق/B001` is tearing or piercing; `خ ر ق/B004` is rough clumsiness and lack of measured skill, while `B003` is fabricated falsehood. The visible hole is packet-supplied, but the causal arrow `لِتُغْرِقَ أَهْلَهَا` is Moses’s inference before the promised report; 18:72–73 marks the sequencing failure. I infer that he reads physical piercing through the dormant clumsiness branch and treats an inferred purpose as settled. The question therefore exposes interpretive fabrication risk without denying the seriousness of the observed damage.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:72–76 reinforced the procedural failure but supplied no explanation within this ayah’s +5 horizon, so the clumsiness activation remains explicitly exploratory here.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir parçayı başka bir nesnedeki yerine geçirip sabitlemeyi çekirdek işlem olarak açıkça kurar. Yüzük taşı ve mızrak ya da ok ucu örnekleri bu işlemi somutlaştırır; takılmış parça ve parçaların düzgün birleşimi de işlemin sonucu olarak adlandırılır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Parça takma işlemi ile takılmış parça ve düzenli birleşim ayrı tutulur; yüzük taşı ve silah ucu örnekleri bütün dalın tek zorunlu nesnesi sayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir parçayı başka bir nesnenin içindeki ya da üzerindeki belirli yerine geçirip sabitlemek ve böylece parçaları düzenli bir bütün halinde birleştirmektir. Takılan parça da bu işlemin sonucu olarak adlandırılabilir.

facets.statement: Bir parça, taşıyıcı nesnedeki belirli yerine geçirilir ve orada sabitlenir.

Yüzük taşının yuvasına ve metal ucun mızrak ya da oka takılması işlemin belirgin örnekleridir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi söyleme fiilinin belirli dil bilgisel ortamlarda sanma fiili gibi işletilmesini anlatır. Bu dal, gerçek söz söyleme eylemi değil, bir yargı veya varsayım kuran gramatik kullanımdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam non_bare olduğu için tanım özel gramatik kullanımın dışına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Söyleme fiilinin bazı yapılarda sanmak veya varsaymak gibi işleyerek sonraki unsurları ona göre kurduğu dil bilgisel kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, söyleme fiilinin sanma ve varsayma işleviyle kullanılmasıdır.
Kullanım özellikle soru yapısıyla sınırlanır, fakat aktarımda daha geniş bir lehçe uygulaması da anılır.
Kaynak içindeki lehçe notu, soru dışı kullanıma da uzanan özel bir genişleme bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt bu özel dalı tek bir aktarım üzerinden verir; ortaklaştırılacak ayrı bir çok kaynaklı iddia yoktur.

source_details.summary: Tekil aktarım, sanmak gibi işleyen söyleme kullanımını ve soru dışına uzanan lehçe notunu verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi önce suda batma ve suyun altında kalma durumunu, ardından başkasını bu duruma düşürmeyi verir. Borç, bela ve nimet altında kalma anlatımları bu fiziksel durumun benzetmeli uzantılarıdır; boğulmak üzere olanın yalvarışı da ayrı bir yapıya bağlı kullanımdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın boğulma anlamını, ettirgen kullanımı, benzetmeli uzantıları ve yalnızca belirli bir söz öbeğinde görülen yalvarış anlamını birbirinden ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Suda batıp suyun altında kalarak boğulmak veya bir başkasını bu duruma düşürmektir. Borç, bela ya da nimet tarafından bütünüyle kuşatılma buna benzetilir; özel bir söz öbeği de kurtuluş ümidi kalmayan kişinin yakarışını anlatır.

facets.statement: Bir kişinin suda batması, su altında kalması ve bunun sonucunda boğulmasıdır.
Bir başkasını su içinde bırakarak boğulmasına yol açan ettirgen kullanım da dalın içindedir.
Borç, bela veya nimet içinde çıkışsız kalma, suyun altında kalmaya benzetilen bir kapsam genişlemesidir.
Boğulmak üzere olanın yakarışı, yalnızca belirli bir söz öbeğinde çaresizce yardım dileme anlamı taşır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar suda batıp boğulmayı ortak çekirdek olarak verir; başkasını boğma ettirgen kullanımdır. Borç, bela ve nimet altında kalma fiziksel boğulmaya benzetilir, özel yakarış sözü ise ancak son çare olarak yardım dilemeyi anlatır.

branches.what_is_ar: الرسوب في الماء والغمر حتى الهلاك؛ وإيقاع الغرق بغيره؛ وما شبه به من دين وبلاء ونعمة
branches.source_phrase_ar: الغرق في الماء (maqayis); رجل غرق وغريق رسب في الماء وابتلي بالدين والبلوى تشبيها به (ayn); غرق في الماء غرقا وأغرقه غيره (sihah); الغرق الرسوب في الماء ويشبه به الذي ركبه الدين وغمرته البلايا (tahdhib); الغرق الرسوب في الماء وفي البلاء وفلان غرق في نعمة فلان تشبيها بذلك (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi öldürmeyi ortak sonuç olarak verir, fakat yenidoğana ilişkin anlatımlar mekanizmayı aynı biçimde sunmaz: bazıları su içinde boğmayı, biri ise doğum sıvısının bebeğin burnuna kaçmasına yol açan özensizliği anlatır. Bu nedenle dal korunabilir, ancak her örneği kasıtlı olarak suya batırma diye okumamak gerekir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, öldürme bildiren biçimi yenidoğanla ilgili kalıpla birlikte verir; yenidoğan örneğinin ayrıntıları genel öldürme anlamına taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Birini sıvı içinde boğarak ya da sıvının solunum yoluna girmesine neden olarak öldürmektir. Yenidoğana ilişkin özgül anlatımdan hareketle aynı adlandırma daha sonra öldürmenin geneline de yayılmıştır.

facets.statement: Bir insanın sıvıyla bağlantılı bir boğulma süreci sonucunda öldürülmesidir.
Özgül anlatıda ebe, yenidoğanı su içinde tutar veya doğum sıvısının burnuna girmesine yol açarak ölümüne neden olur.
Sıvıyla boğma anlamından hareketle söz, araç belirtilmeden genel olarak öldürme için de kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak sonucu öldürmedir. Yenidoğan örneği kimi anlatımda su içinde boğma, kimi anlatımda doğum sıvısının burna girmesine yol açma biçimindedir; bu özgül kullanımdan genel öldürme anlamına geçildiği de belirtilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir yalın anlamdan çok, yapıya bağlı iki düzen kurar: atın sürüye karıştıktan sonra onu geçmesi ve bir şeyin alanı bütünüyle kaplaması ya da tüketmesi. Nefes, bakış ve koşum takımı örnekleri ikinci düzenin farklı katılımcılar üzerindeki gerçekleşmeleridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, at yarışı yapısını kapsama bildiren biçim ve söz öbeklerinden ayırır; hiçbir özel kullanım yalın kökün tek anlamı sayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kullanımda atın öteki atların arasına karışıp ardından hepsini geçmesi, başka kullanımlarda ise bir eylem veya nesnenin ilgili alanı ya da kapasiteyi bütünüyle kaplamasıdır. Nefesi sonuna kadar verme, bütün bakışları üzerinde toplama ve gövdenin koşum takımına sığmayacak ölçüde büyümesi bu ikinci düzenin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir alanın, sürenin veya kapasitenin hiçbir pay bırakmadan bütünüyle kapsanmasıdır.
At yarışında atın sürüye karışması ve bu karışmanın ardından öteki atları geçmesi iki aşamalı bir kullanımdır.
Nefes kullanımında soluk verme sürecinin bütün kapasitesi sonuna kadar kullanılır.
Bakış kullanımında bir kişi insanların dikkat alanını tümüyle kendisine bağlayıp başkasına pay bırakmaz.
Koşum kullanımında hayvanın yanları ve karnı, göğüs ve karın kayışlarının çevreleyebileceği alanı bütünüyle doldurur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar atın öteki atlara karışıp sonra onları geçmesini ayrı bir yarış yapısı olarak verir. Kapsama düzeninde ise soluk verme bütünüyle sürdürülür, bir kişi bütün bakışları kendine çeker veya iri gövde koşum kayışlarının alanını doldurup onları dar bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişinin eşi ve en yakınları, bir evin sakinleri ve aynı din, soy, iş, ev ya da belde bağıyla toplanan kişileri birlikte verir. Bu yüzden dalın merkezi, soyla sınırlı olmayan fakat yakınlık ve aidiyet bağıyla kurulan insan topluluğudur.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişiye, eve, dine, soya, işe, beldeye ya da ortak yaşama alanına yakınlık ve aidiyet bağıyla bağlı olan insan çevresidir. Eş ve en yakın kişiler çekirdekte durur; ev sakinleri ve ortak bağla birleşen topluluklar bu çekirdeğin genişlemeleridir.

Din, soy, iş, ev veya belde ortaklığı insanları aynı aidiyet çevresinde toplayabilir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أهل الرجل وزوجه وأخص الناس به، وسكان البيت، وأهل الدين أو النسب أو الصناعة أو البلد ومن يجمعهم مسكن أو رابطة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أهل الرجل زوجه وأخص الناس به؛ أهل البيت سكانه؛ أهل الإسلام من يدين به (maqayis;ayn;tahdhib)؛ أهل الرجل من يجمعه وإياهم نسب أو دين أو صناعة وبيت وبلد (mufradat)؛ أهل الرجال وأهل الدار (sihah)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه التأهل والتزوج، وأهل الرجل أو أهل امرأة، والدعاء بآهلك الله في الجنة أي زوجك فيها وجعل لك أهلا.
يدخل فيه فلان أهل لكذا أو خليق به، وأهل التقوى والمغفرة، وتأهيل الشخص لأمر.
يدخل فيه المكان المأهول أو الآهل، وكون الشيء أو الدابة يألف مكانا فيكون أهليا، والأنس بالإنسان أو المكان.
يدخل فيه قول مرحبا وأهلا في التحية، بمعنى وجدت سعة وأتيت أهلا لا غرباء فاستأنس ولا تستوحش.
يدخل فيه الإهالة: الألية أو الودك أو الشحم أو الزيت وما يؤتدم به، وما يعلو القدر من ودك اللحم السمين، واستأهل بمعنى أخذ الإهالة أو أكلها أو ائتدم بها.

branches.source_phrase_ar: العجب، لقد جئت شيئا إمرا (maqayis)؛ أمر أمره أي اشتد والاسم الإمر، ويقال عجبا (sihah)؛ لقد جئت شيئا إمرا أي جئت شيئا عظيما من المنكر (tahdhib)؛ إمرا أي منكرا، من قولهم أمر الأمر أي كبر وكثر (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه المؤامرة والائتمار والاستئمار والتآمر، أي مشاورة النفس أو الغير، وقبول الرأي أو العزم عليه.
يدخل فيه الإمر أو الإمرة للرجل الضعيف الرأي أو الأحمق الذي يستأمر كل أحد ويأتمر لكل أمر.
يدخل فيه الإمر لولد الضأن أو الخروف، والإمرة للأنثى أو الرخل.
يدخل فيه الأمر بمعنى الإبداع والإنشاء المختص بالله، والتعبير عن سرعة الإيجاد بالقول.
يدخل فيه السنان المؤمر أي المحدد، وأمر القناة بمعنى جعل سنان فيها.
